sheepdog: sample, validate and calibrate BirdNET detections

Source: R/sheepdog-package.R
sheepdog-package.Rd

sheepdog draws clips of BirdNET predictions for manual review, summarises the verdicts, calibrates the confidence scores into probabilities of true detection and builds detection histories and community matrices from them. Start with vignette("sheepdog").

Glossary

The terms below are used with these meanings throughout the documentation and the vignettes.

  • Prediction or detection: one row of a BirdNET selection table, a species code with a confidence score for a time window of a recording.

  • Confidence or score: the BirdNET output in (0, 1). It is not a probability that the prediction is correct until calibrated.

  • Verdict: the outcome of the manual review of a clip, "positive" (true positive, TP) or "negative" (false positive, FP).

  • Precision: the share of the reviewed predictions above a score threshold that are true positives, TP / (TP + FP). Weighted precision weights each clip by 1 / inclusion_prob.

  • Occasion: the sampling unit of the random designs and of the occupancy export, one recording (occasion_unit = "file") or one minute of a recording ("minute"); see vignette("crywolf-integration").

  • Inclusion probability (inclusion_prob): the probability that a clip or occasion was drawn, n_drawn / n_candidates within its stratum and score band. Weights 1 / inclusion_prob make the drawn units stand for all the candidates.

  • Recall ceiling: the share of the occasions in which a species called (by manual annotation of whole recordings) that have at least one prediction of it above min_confidence; no threshold recovers more (see recall_ceiling()).

  • P(TP): the probability that a prediction is a true positive, predicted by a calibration model from its score, species and site.

  • Calibration model: a logistic regression of the verdicts on the logit of the score, logit_conf, with species and site effects (see calibration_models() and fit_calibration()).

  • Calibration intercept and slope: the coefficients of a logistic regression of held-out verdicts on the logit of the predicted P(TP). A well calibrated model has intercept 0 and slope 1; a slope below 1 means probabilities that are too extreme.

  • p_min: the P(TP) above which a detection is taken as reliable when detection histories are built.

  • Detection history: for each site, species and night, whether the species was detected by at least min_detections_night reliable detections (see detection_history()).

  • R-hat, bulk and tail ESS: convergence diagnostics of a Bayesian fit, the potential scale reduction factor and the effective sample sizes of the centre and of the tails of the posterior (see calibration_diagnostics()).

Option arguments

Arguments that take one of a set of strings (such as engine, sampling_mode or occasion_unit) are case-sensitive. Most are matched with match.arg(), which also accepts unambiguous partial matches: engine = "brms" and engine = "b" work, but engine = "BRMS" raises an error listing the allowed values. The others are compared exactly, without partial matching.

Input tables and missing values

Every function that takes a table accepts a data.frame, a tibble or a data.table and converts it to a tibble on entry, so the result does not depend on the class of the input. Numeric columns lose extra classes (such as those of the 'units' package) and list columns among the columns a function uses raise an error.

Rows with a missing value in a column a function needs (the score and the audio path of a prediction; the variables of a calibration formula; the score of a clip reviewed with "top", "random_detections" or "score_bands") are left out with a message that says how many. Set options(sheepdog.missing = "error") to stop with an error instead. Missing values are never imputed. A reviewed clip without a score is not a missing value when it comes from "random_recordings" (whole recordings have no score); when a table of reviewed clips has no sampling_mode column, every clip without a score is taken as such a recording and left out of the precision and the thresholds without a message.
